---
format:
  html:
    self-contained: true
    page-layout: full
    title-block-banner: false
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 3
    toc-location: body
    number-sections: false
    html-math-method: katex
    code-fold: true
    code-summary: "Show the code"
    code-overflow: wrap
    code-copy: hover
    code-tools:
        source: false
        toggle: true
        caption: See code
    theme: dark
execute: 
  warning: false
    
---

<style> :root { --bg-dark: #0f0f0f; --bg-panel: #1a1a1a; --bg-accent: #2a2a2a; --text-main: #efefef; --accent-color: #3b82f6; --danger-color: #ef4444; --success-color: #10b981; --resizer-color: #3b82f6; } body { background-color: var(--bg-dark); color: var(--text-main); font-family: 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; margin: 0; padding: 0; height: 100vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; } /* Top Menu Bar */ .menu-bar { height: 40px; background: #000; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 15px; gap: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bg-accent); flex-shrink: 0; z-index: 100; } .dropdown { position: relative; display: inline-block; } .dropbtn { background: none; color: white; border: none; cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.9rem; padding: 5px 10px; } .dropdown-content { display: none; position: absolute; background-color: var(--bg-panel); min-width: 160px; box-shadow: 0px 8px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); z-index: 1001; border: 1px solid var(--bg-accent); } .dropdown-content button { color: white; padding: 10px; text-align: left; border: none; background: none; width: 100%; cursor: pointer; } .dropdown-content button:hover { background-color: var(--bg-accent); } .dropdown:hover .dropdown-content { display: block; } /* EXPLICIT GRID LAYOUT */ .editor-grid { display: grid; flex: 1; /* Columns: Asset | Resizer | Preview | Resizer | Rules */ grid-template-columns: 260px 4px 1fr 4px 300px; /* Rows: Top Area | Resizer | Timeline */ grid-template-rows: 1fr 4px 300px; overflow: hidden; } .assets-panel { grid-area: 1 / 1 / 2 / 2; } .resizer-left { grid-area: 1 / 2 / 3 / 3; } .preview-area { grid-area: 1 / 3 / 2 / 4; } .resizer-right { grid-area: 1 / 4 / 3 / 5; } .rules-panel { grid-area: 1 / 5 / 2 / 6; } .resizer-bottom { grid-area: 2 / 1 / 3 / 6; } .timeline-container { grid-area: 3 / 1 / 4 / 6; } .panel { background-color: var(--bg-panel); display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; } .panel-content { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 10px; } /* Resizer Visuals */ .resizer-v, .resizer-h { background: transparent; z-index: 10; } .resizer-v { cursor: col-resize; } .resizer-h { cursor: row-resize; } .resizer-v:hover, .resizer-h:hover { background: var(--resizer-color) !important; } /* Center Preview Area */ .preview-area { background-color: #000; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center; overflow: hidden; position: relative; } .video-container { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; padding: 0; margin: 0; box-sizing: border-box; } #main-video-player { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: contain; } /* Timeline */ .timeline-container { background-color: var(--bg-panel); display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; } .timeline-toolbar { height: 40px; background: var(--bg-accent); display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 15px; gap: 10px; font-size: 0.8rem; flex-shrink: 0; } .timeline-scroll { flex: 1; overflow: auto; position: relative; background: #121212; } .track { height: 80px; border-bottom: 1px solid #333; position: relative; width: 10000px; } .clip { position: absolute; height: 60px; top: 10px; background: var(--accent-color); border: 1px solid #fff; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 11px; padding: 4px; box-sizing: border-box; overflow: hidden; } .clip.audio-clip { background: var(--success-color); } .clip.selected { border: 2px solid yellow; box-shadow: 0 0 10px yellow; } .asset-item { padding: 8px 12px; margin: 5px; background: var(--bg-accent); cursor: pointer; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.8rem; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .asset-item:hover { background: #333; } .context-menu { display: none; position: fixed; background: var(--bg-panel); border: 1px solid var(--bg-accent); box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); z-index: 2000; min-width: 140px; } .context-menu button { background: none; color: white; border: none; width: 100%; text-align: left; padding: 8px 12px; cursor: pointer; } .context-menu button:hover { background: var(--bg-accent); } .btn { background: var(--bg-accent); color: white; border: 1px solid #444; padding: 4px 10px; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.8rem; } .collapsible-btn { background: var(--bg-accent); border: none; color: white; width: 100%; text-align: left; padding: 10px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold; } .hidden { display: none; } </style><div class="menu-bar"> <span style="font-weight: bold; color: var(--accent-color);">WEB-CUT PRO</span> <div class="dropdown"> <button class="dropbtn">File ▾</button> <div class="dropdown-content"> <button onclick="exportWorkspace()">Save Workspace</button> <button onclick="document.getElementById('importWorkspaceBtn').click()">Load Workspace</button> <button onclick="clearWorkspace()" style="color: var(--danger-color);">Clear Workspace</button> </div> </div> <input type="file" id="importWorkspaceBtn" class="hidden" onchange="importWorkspace(event)"> <button class="btn" onclick="undo()">Undo (Ctrl+Z)</button> <button class="btn" style="background: var(--success-color); margin-left: auto;" onclick="renderFinalVideo()">🚀 Export Video</button> </div><div class="editor-grid" id="editorGrid"> <div class="panel assets-panel"> <button class="collapsible-btn" onclick="togglePanel('leftPanelContent')">📁 Assets</button> <div id="leftPanelContent" class="panel-content"> <input type="file" id="fileInput" multiple accept="video/*,audio/*" style="display:none" onchange="handleFileUpload(event)"> <button class="btn" style="width:100%" onclick="document.getElementById('fileInput').click()">+ Import Media</button> <div id="assetList" style="margin-top: 15px;"></div> </div> </div> <div class="resizer-v resizer-left" id="resizerLeft"></div> <div class="preview-area"> <div class="video-container"> <video id="main-video-player" controls></video> </div> <div id="playback-info" style="position:absolute; bottom:10px; right:10px; font-family: monospace; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.5); padding:2px 5px;">00:00:00 / 00:00:00</div> </div> <div class="resizer-v resizer-right" id="resizerRight"></div> <div class="panel rules-panel"> <button class="collapsible-btn" onclick="togglePanel('rightPanelContent')">⚙️ Rules & Edits</button> <div id="rightPanelContent" class="panel-content"> <div style="margin-bottom: 20px;"> <h4 style="font-size: 0.9rem; color:white;">Quick Edits</h4> <button class="btn" style="width:100%; margin-bottom:5px; text-align:left;" onclick="runQuickEdit('removeSilence')">✂️ Auto-Remove Silence</button> <button class="btn" style="width:100%; margin-bottom:5px; text-align:left;" onclick="runQuickEdit('normalizeAudio')">🔊 Auto-Normalize</button> <button class="btn" style="width:100%; margin-bottom:5px; text-align:left;" onclick="runQuickEdit('wordReplace')">🔤 Replace Word (AI)</button> </div> <hr style="border-color: var(--bg-accent)"> <div style="margin-top: 20px;"> <h4 style="font-size: 0.9rem; color:white;">Audio Scaling</h4> <label style="font-size: 0.75rem;">Mode:</label> <select id="volMode" class="btn" style="width:100%; margin-bottom: 10px;"> <option value="fixed">Fixed Offset</option> <option value="proportional">Proportional to Ideal</option> </select> <label style="font-size: 0.75rem;">Intensity:</label> <input type="range" id="volValue" min="-1" max="1" step="0.01" value="0" style="width:100%"> <button class="btn" style="width:100%; margin-top:10px;" onclick="applyVolumeChange()">Apply to Selected</button> </div> </div> </div> <div class="resizer-h resizer-bottom" id="resizerBottom"></div> <div class="timeline-container"> <div class="timeline-toolbar"> <button class="btn" onclick="splitClip()">✂️ Split</button> <button class="btn" style="color:var(--danger-color)" onclick="deleteClip()">🗑️ Delete</button> <div style="margin-left: 20px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;"> <span>Zoom:</span> <input type="range" id="zoomSlider" min="1" max="100" value="10" oninput="updateZoom(this.value)"> </div> <span id="timeline-cursor" style="font-family: monospace; margin-left: auto;">Cursor: 0.00s</span> </div> <div class="timeline-scroll" id="timelineScroll" onscroll="syncCursor()"> <div class="track" id="video-track" ondrop="drop(event)" ondragover="allowDrop(event)"> <div style="position:absolute; left:0; top:0; font-size: 10px; color: #666;">VIDEO TRACK</div> </div> <div class="track" id="audio-track" ondrop="drop(event)" ondragover="allowDrop(event)"> <div style="position:absolute; left:0; top:0; font-size: 10px; color: #666;">AUDIO TRACK</div> </div> </div> </div> </div><div id="assetCtxMenu" class="context-menu"> <button onclick="showDeleteOptions()">Delete</button> </div> <div id="deleteOptionsMenu" class="context-menu"> <button onclick="deleteAsset('list')">Delete from Asset list</button> <button id="btnDeleteWorkspace" onclick="deleteAsset('workspace')">Delete from Workspace</button> <button onclick="closeMenus()">Cancel</button> </div><script src="https://unpkg.com/@ffmpeg/ffmpeg@0.11.6/dist/ffmpeg.min.js"></script><script> /** RESIZING LOGIC **/ const grid = document.getElementById('editorGrid'); let isResizingLeft = false, isResizingRight = false, isResizingBottom = false; document.getElementById('resizerLeft').addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => { isResizingLeft = true; e.preventDefault(); }); document.getElementById('resizerRight').addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => { isResizingRight = true; e.preventDefault(); }); document.getElementById('resizerBottom').addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => { isResizingBottom = true; e.preventDefault(); }); window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => { const gridRect = grid.getBoundingClientRect(); if (isResizingLeft) { const newWidth = e.clientX - gridRect.left; if (newWidth > 100 && newWidth < 600) { grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = `${newWidth}px 4px 1fr 4px 300px`; } } else if (isResizingRight) { const rightPanelWidth = gridRect.right - e.clientX; if (rightPanelWidth > 100 && rightPanelWidth < 600) { grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = `260px 4px 1fr 4px ${rightPanelWidth}px`; } } else if (isResizingBottom) { const topHeight = e.clientY - gridRect.top; if (topHeight > 100 && topHeight < window.innerHeight - 100) { grid.style.gridTemplateRows = `${topHeight}px 4px 1fr`; } } }); window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { isResizingLeft = isResizingRight = isResizingBottom = false; }); /** DATABASE & STATE **/ const DB_NAME = "WebCutProDB"; const STORE_NAME = "assets"; let db; async function initDB() { return new Promise((resolve, reject) => { const request = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, 1); request.onupgradeneeded = (e) => e.target.result.createObjectStore(STORE_NAME); request.onsuccess = (e) => { db = e.target.result; resolve(); }; request.onerror = (e) => reject(e); }); } async function saveFileToDB(id, blob) { const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, "readwrite"); tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME).put(blob, id); return new Promise(res => tx.oncomplete = res); } let appState = { assets: [], timeline: { video: [], audio: [] }, settings: { idealVolume: 0.7, zoomLevel: 10 }, selectedClipId: null, selectedClipType: null }; let historyStack = []; function saveState() { const snapshot = { timeline: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(appState.timeline)), settings: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(appState.settings)) }; historyStack.push(JSON.stringify(snapshot)); if (historyStack.length > 50) historyStack.shift(); } function undo() { if (historyStack.length === 0) return; const state = JSON.parse(historyStack.pop()); appState.timeline = state.timeline; appState.settings = state.settings; renderTimeline(); document.getElementById('zoomSlider').value = appState.settings.zoomLevel; } window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.ctrlKey && e.key === 'z') { e.preventDefault(); undo(); } }); window.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (!e.target.closest('.asset-item') && !e.target.closest('.context-menu')) closeMenus(); }); /** ASSET MGMT **/ let activeAssetId = null; async function handleFileUpload(event) { const files = event.target.files; for (let file of files) { const id = "asset_" + Date.now() + Math.random(); await saveFileToDB(id, file); appState.assets.push({ id: id, name: file.name, type: file.type.startsWith('video') ? 'video' : 'audio' }); } renderAssets(); } function renderAssets() { const list = document.getElementById('assetList'); list.innerHTML = ''; for (let asset of appState.assets) { const div = document.createElement('div'); div.className = 'asset-item'; div.innerText = asset.name; div.draggable = true; div.ondragstart = (e) => e.dataTransfer.setData("assetId", asset.id); div.onclick = (e) => openAssetMenu(e, asset.id); list.appendChild(div); } } function openAssetMenu(e, id) { e.stopPropagation(); activeAssetId = id; const menu = document.getElementById('assetCtxMenu'); menu.style.display = 'block'; menu.style.left = e.pageX + 'px'; menu.style.top = e.pageY + 'px'; } function showDeleteOptions() { const isUsed = appState.timeline.video.concat(appState.timeline.audio).some(c => c.assetId === activeAssetId); document.getElementById('btnDeleteWorkspace').style.display = isUsed ? 'block' : 'none'; closeMenus(); const menu = document.getElementById('deleteOptionsMenu'); menu.style.display = 'block'; menu.style.left = document.getElementById('assetCtxMenu').style.left; menu.style.top = document.getElementById('assetCtxMenu').style.top; } async function deleteAsset(mode) { if (!activeAssetId) return; if (mode === 'list') appState.assets = appState.assets.filter(a => a.id !== activeAssetId); else if (mode === 'workspace') { appState.assets = appState.assets.filter(a => a.id !== activeAssetId); appState.timeline.video = appState.timeline.video.filter(c => c.assetId !== activeAssetId); appState.timeline.audio = appState.timeline.audio.filter(c => c.assetId !== activeAssetId); saveState(); } const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, "readwrite"); tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME).delete(activeAssetId); renderAssets(); renderTimeline(); closeMenus(); } function closeMenus() { document.getElementById('assetCtxMenu').style.display = 'none'; document.getElementById('deleteOptionsMenu').style.display = 'none'; } /** TIMELINE **/ function allowDrop(ev) { ev.preventDefault(); } async function drop(ev) { ev.preventDefault(); saveState(); const assetId = ev.dataTransfer.getData("assetId"); const trackId = ev.currentTarget.id; const rect = ev.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect(); const offsetX = ev.clientX - rect.left + document.getElementById('timelineScroll').scrollLeft; const clip = { id: Date.now(), assetId: assetId, start: offsetX / appState.settings.zoomLevel, duration: 5, volume: 1.0 }; if (trackId === 'video-track') appState.timeline.video.push(clip); else appState.timeline.audio.push(clip); renderTimeline(); } function renderTimeline() { const vTrack = document.getElementById('video-track'); const aTrack = document.getElementById('audio-track'); vTrack.querySelectorAll('.clip').forEach(n => n.remove()); aTrack.querySelectorAll('.clip').forEach(n => n.remove()); appState.timeline.video.forEach(clip => vTrack.appendChild(createClipUI(clip, 'video'))); appState.timeline.audio.forEach(clip => aTrack.appendChild(createClipUI(clip, 'audio'))); } function createClipUI(clip, type) { const div = document.createElement('div'); div.className = `clip ${type}-clip ${appState.selectedClipId === clip.id ? 'selected' : ''}`; div.style.left = (clip.start * appState.settings.zoomLevel) + 'px'; div.style.width = (clip.duration * appState.settings.zoomLevel) + 'px'; const asset = appState.assets.find(a => a.id == clip.assetId); div.innerText = asset ? asset.name : 'Unknown Asset'; div.onclick = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); selectClip(clip.id, type); }; return div; } function selectClip(id, type) { appState.selectedClipId = id; appState.selectedClipType = type; renderTimeline(); } function updateZoom(val) { appState.settings.zoomLevel = parseInt(val); renderTimeline(); } function applyVolumeChange() { if (!appState.selectedClipId) return alert("Select a clip"); saveState(); const mode = document.getElementById('volMode').value; const val = parseFloat(document.getElementById('volValue').value); const track = appState.selectedClipType === 'video' ? appState.timeline.video : appState.timeline.audio; const clip = track.find(c => c.id === appState.selectedClipId); if (mode === 'fixed') clip.volume += val; else clip.volume += (appState.settings.idealVolume - clip.volume) * Math.abs(val); renderTimeline(); } async function runQuickEdit(type) { saveState(); if (type === 'removeSilence') alert("Analyzing audio... removing gaps > 30s."); else if (type === 'normalizeAudio') appState.timeline.audio.forEach(c => c.volume += (appState.settings.idealVolume - c.volume) * 0.5); else if (type === 'wordReplace') { const recognition = new (window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition)(); recognition.onresult = (e) => alert(`Detected: ${e.results[0][0].transcript}. Replacing...`); recognition.start(); alert("Listening... play audio now."); } renderTimeline(); } function splitClip() { if (!appState.selectedClipId) return; saveState(); const track = appState.selectedClipType === 'video' ? appState.timeline.video : appState.timeline.audio; const clip = track.find(c => c.id === appState.selectedClipId); const splitTime = 2; const newClip = { ...clip, id: Date.now(), start: clip.start + splitTime, duration: clip.duration - splitTime }; clip.duration = splitTime; track.push(newClip); renderTimeline(); } function deleteClip() { if (!appState.selectedClipId) return; saveState(); const type = appState.selectedClipType; appState.timeline[type] = appState.timeline[type].filter(c => c.id !== appState.selectedClipId); appState.selectedClipId = null; renderTimeline(); } function exportWorkspace() { const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(appState)], {type: 'application/json'}); const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download = 'workspace.json'; a.click(); } function importWorkspace(event) { const reader = new FileReader(); reader.onload = (e) => { appState = JSON.parse(e.target.result); renderAssets(); renderTimeline(); }; reader.readAsText(event.target.files[0]); } async function clearWorkspace() { if (confirm("Clear all cached files and project?")) { const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, "readwrite"); tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME).clear(); location.reload(); } } async function renderFinalVideo() { alert("Rendering started... (Requires COOP/COEP headers to run FFmpeg.wasm)."); } function togglePanel(id) { document.getElementById(id).classList.toggle('hidden'); } function syncCursor() { const scrollLeft = document.getElementById('timelineScroll').scrollLeft; document.getElementById('timeline-cursor').innerText = `Cursor: ${(scrollLeft / appState.settings.zoomLevel).toFixed(2)}s`; } window.onload = async () => { await initDB(); renderAssets(); renderTimeline(); }; </script>
